title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar: fixed-price proposal and cost review
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 states that nickel and alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so current market movements do not justify an immediate full surcharge.

Could you arrange the calculation review offered by your owner in doc:20260421-70710-M2, separating material and processing costs?

We propose €5.35/kg fixed, 60 days net and a 24-month commitment for 94,800 kg annually, with the specified DAP delivery and 10-day lead time. This provides dependable call-offs over two years without double-counting alloy movements. Can you obtain an authorized review of this complete package?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar: fixed-price proposal and cost review
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate the proposed 24-month commitment and can agree to the 60-day payment terms, but a fixed price over two years is not possible and requires an AS-14404 index clause. 

With this index clause applied, we can offer a revised base price of €5.55 per kg. For our full current Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €5.55 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Regarding costs, material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address the cost breakdown; in the meantime, please share the data underlying your assessment of current market movements.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Revised base price and AS-14404 deadband
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

The AS-14404 series increased from 2839.7103 (idx:AS-14404@2025-09) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a recorded 5.92%, supporting a distinction between the base price and future alloy adjustments.

We can accommodate indexation if the package includes a 5% deadband and a lower base price. Please review €5.35/kg, 60 days net and 24 months, with the agreed DAP delivery and 10-day lead time.

Would a 36-month commitment enable approval of this package? We offer that alternative at the same price. Please have the authorized pricing decision-maker review both options; no confidential margin disclosure is needed.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Revised base price and AS-14404 deadband
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are always eager to support your operations with our extensive inventory and dedicated service. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While we acknowledge the verified AS-14404 index data, our alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning current market falls do not reduce our costs. We cannot accommodate a 5% deadband, but following an internal review, we are pleased to offer a reduced base price of €5.52 per unit. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.52 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Revised indexed package for approval
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the two alternatives. The €5.52 package without a deadband has the lower evaluated total cost; please make that your primary offer rather than the €5.65 package.

Could your authorized pricing decision-maker approve €5.40/kg with the same index clause and 60-day payment against a 36-month commitment? Alternatively, we propose €5.45/kg for 24 months. Both retain the specified annual volume, DAP delivery and 10-day lead time.

Which commitment provides the better pricing opportunity? We are not requesting further confidential cost details.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Revised indexed package for approval
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We can accept your terms and await your order. Ourangebot provides a price of €5.45 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We offer a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, though our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This represents a significant concession to support your operations and secure a long-term partnership. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C, and we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Revised indexed package for approval
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
